title: Eight Sleep film band
description: A full-bleed, dimly lit film band: a looping bedroom video fills it edge to edge, a single centered white line (two on phones) sits over it with a white 'play the film' button and a play-circle icon, and a tiny play toggle rests in the bottom-right corner. As tall as the window allows, up to 640px.
notes: dark-scoped; height is min(640px, 80svh), as the original
the video slot is a dark placeholder when empty; the corner toggle is decoration unless onToggle is wired
name: eightsleep-film

props.name: cta
props.type: { label: ReactNode; href?: string | undefined; onClick?: (() => void) | undefined; }
props.description: the white button, e.g. to open the film

props.name: media
props.description: the looping background video (or a still), cover-fitted

props.name: toggleLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the small corner play toggle; leave out to hide it
